nl: 课程报名管理：查询有学员姓名、课程名称；表格展示学员姓名、课程名称、手机号、备用邮箱；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「备用邮箱」在「手机号」已填写时隐藏（已留手机号就不必再留邮箱）。
nlEn: Course enrollment management: query by student name and course name; the table shows student name, course name, phone, and backup email; supports add, edit, and delete. In the form, "backup email" is hidden once the "phone" is filled in (no need for an email if a phone is already on file).
notes: AI-06: isHidden op=notEmpty — 手机号已填时隐藏备用邮箱（antdv/sfc）
